source_text.GH#2700: TypeAccess on primary and every join target (/query, export, aggregate). Design gate with refusal-shape ruling.

task.description: SECURITY-REVIEWER CODE gate for GH #2700 (commit c674cb1e1). Read-only; no lib/ or test/ edits; no mix run.

result.summary: CODE gate PASS. RequestAccess.check/4 order is request_entity_types (primary, then join through/entity_type; unwalked/malformed/non-binary primary fail closed, never raises) -> TypeAccess.denied_types (one tenant lookup, one query, typed array param, uniq, [] no I/O, UUID cast, queried in the auth-context prefix) -> ensure_all_visible reads Allowlist.fk_defs for EVERY type via Enum.map (no short-circuit, R1), one decision, any non-{:ok,_} read fails closed to :entity_type_not_found, :invalid_schema_name preserved -> FieldPolicy.check_request unchanged. Denied and absent are the same {:error,:entity_type_not_found} from the same exit: /query maps to render_type_hidden 200-empty, export and aggregate to the shared 404 clause (identical to a nonexistent type). Unredacted export: exempt? forwarded only to check_request, never lifts type denial; the 403 for a missing unredacted permission is type-independent (precedes the gate). No Logger/audit on denial; audit_exempted runs only after the gate. Old guard_row_request and the after-compile TypeAccess step removed with no loss: sets from RequestAccess still reach redact/3 and export_redact. Principal/prefix come from auth context only (INV-1). Other Compiler.compile callers (script_reads, exam session/snapshot/anti_cheat, seed task) build server-constructed single-type queries with no caller joins: out of scope. render_get_definition TypeAccess.authorized? unchanged. Non-blocking notes: shape errors (too_many_joins, depth, duplicate target) precede denial/existence by design (request-structure facts, design ruling); tests must pin identical status/body for denied vs absent at primary, direct, far and through hops, the tripwire for @entity_type_classes, and the no-short-circuit query count.
